meta.title: For Employers — NestSelf
meta.description: Give your team confidential access to therapy, legal and financial support. Launch in weeks, see anonymised insights, and know your people have real help when they need it.

hero.title: A wellbeing benefit your people will actually use
hero.lead: NestSelf gives your employees confidential access to licensed psychologists, legal professionals and financial consultants — plus wellbeing check-ins, webinars and resources. You see anonymised workforce insights for groups of 10 or more. You never see who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

items.title: Therapy & Counselling
items.body: Licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists for individual, couples and family sessions — online or in person.

items.title: Legal Consultation
items.body: Confidential guidance on personal legal matters — family law, tenancy, consumer rights. Excludes workplace disputes with the employer.

items.title: Financial Guidance
items.body: Budgeting, debt management, savings planning and retirement guidance from certified financial professionals.

items.title: Webinars
items.body: Live and on-demand expert sessions on stress, parenting, finances and more.

items.title: Resources
items.body: Articles, guides and self-help tools your team can access any time.

items.title: Wellbeing check-ins
items.body: Short, validated questionnaires that help employees understand their wellbeing and find the right support — not a diagnosis.

items.title: Family support
items.body: Where your plan includes family members, partners and children access the same services at no extra cost.

whatHrGets.title: What HR gets
paragraphs: You see the big picture without ever seeing individual data. NestSelf gives people leaders anonymised, aggregated wellbeing trends — for groups of 10 or more — so you can spot patterns and plan ahead.
Your NestSelf contact is with you from day one: planning the launch, configuring your plan, preparing communications, briefing managers and reviewing results each quarter.

steps.title: Kick-off and plan configuration
steps.body: We agree on the plan, eligible groups and languages. You choose what is included.

steps.title: Eligibility file and access setup
steps.body: You share an eligibility list. We set up secure, private access for every eligible person.

steps.title: Go-live and manager briefing
steps.body: Employees get access. Managers receive a short briefing on how to point someone to support.

steps.title: Quarterly reviews
steps.body: Your NestSelf contact shares anonymised insights and recommendations each quarter.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality and compliance
paragraphs: Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more.
All professionals are bound by professional secrecy. We sign a data processing agreement and comply with GDPR and local data protection law. No individual-level data is ever shared with the employer.

items.question: What is NestSelf?
items.answer: NestSelf is an employee wellbeing programme that gives your people confidential access to licensed psychologists, legal professionals and financial consultants — plus wellbeing check-ins, webinars and resources.

items.question: What services are included?
items.answer: Depending on your plan: Therapy & Counselling, Legal Consultation, Financial Guidance, Webinars, Resources, Wellbeing check-ins, Manager support and Family support.

items.question: How does it differ from a traditional EAP?
items.answer: Traditional EAPs often limit sessions and cover only psychological support. NestSelf includes legal and financial guidance, resources, manager support and anonymised workforce insights — all in one benefit.

items.question: Who is covered — only employees, or family members too?
items.answer: That depends on your plan. Where your plan includes family members, partners and children access the same services at no extra cost.

items.question: What data does the employer see?
items.answer: You see anonymised, aggregated wellbeing trends for groups of 10 or more. You never see who used NestSelf, what was discussed or individual assessment results.

items.question: How is confidentiality protected?
items.answer: All professionals are bound by professional secrecy. We sign a data processing agreement, comply with GDPR and local data protection law, and never share individual-level data with the employer.

items.question: How quickly can we launch?
items.answer: From signed agreement to employee access in two to four weeks, depending on the size of your organisation and the number of languages.

items.question: What languages are supported?
items.answer: Sessions and resources are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English. Communications materials are prepared in your chosen languages.
